Historical recipe: Cucumber Sauce I
Fannie Merritt Farmer, revised 1910 edition; CHAPTER XVIII FISH AND MEAT SAUCES. Original period measures and oven terms.
Grate two cucumbers, drain, and season with salt, pepper, and vinegar. Serve with Broiled Fish.

text:
Historical recipe: Cucumber Sauce II
Fannie Merritt Farmer, revised 1910 edition; CHAPTER XVIII FISH AND MEAT SAUCES. Original period measures and oven terms.
Beat one-half cup heavy cream until stiff, and add one-fourth teaspoon salt, few grains pepper, and gradually two tablespoons vinegar; then add one cucumber, pared, chopped, and drained.

Historical recipe: Vinaigrette Sauce
Fannie Merritt Farmer, revised 1910 edition; CHAPTER XVIII FISH AND MEAT SAUCES. Original period measures and oven terms.
1 teaspoon salt
¼ teaspoon paprika
Few grains pepper
1 tablespoon tarragon vinegar
2 tablespoons cider vinegar
6 tablespoons olive oil
1 tablespoon chopped pickles
1 tablespoon chopped green pepper
1 teaspoon chopped parsley
1 teaspoon chopped chives
Mix ingredients in order given.

text:
Historical recipe: Apricot Sauce
Fannie Merritt Farmer, revised 1910 edition; CHAPTER XXIV PUDDING SAUCES. Original period measures and oven terms.
¾ cup apricot pulp
¾ cup heavy cream
Sugar
Drain canned apricots from their syrup, and rub through a sieve. Beat cream until stiff, add to apricot pulp, and sweeten to taste. Serve with German toast.
